name: Busa Standup
description: Team standup board: check-ins, blockers, and missing-check-in reminders

agentPrompts.label: Show today's standup board
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-standup` skill in this folder, then open today's board and summarize who has and hasn't checked in, the team digest, and any blockers or reminders waiting on me.

agentPrompts.label: Collect today's updates
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-standup` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then collect today's standup updates from wherever the team posted them (Slack, WeCom, Discord, WhatsApp, a shared doc, or pasted text) and get today's board ready for me to review.

agentPrompts.label: Review drafted reminders
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-standup` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the drafted reminders for missing check-ins or aging blockers so I can approve, edit, or block each one before anything is sent.
